item.title: How Important is SQL for Data Analysis?
item.description:
Using Structured Query Language SQL for data analysis has many benefits. SQL is a very usefull tool for data analysis and can provide great insight into a wide range of topics. it allows users to quickly extract data from databases and easily analyze it, which can lead to better decision-making.

Importance of sql for data-analysis - Sqlpey.com

SQL is extremely efficient and can be used to quickly query large datasets (including Big Data ), giving users the ability to quickly deliver results. It is standardized and portable, making it easier to transfer data between databases and other platforms.
